home.corporateTitle: Safety is our commitment, your workplace is our priority.
home.corporateText: As Mira Occupational Health and Safety Equipment, we are the leading distributor of occupational health and safety equipment in Türkiye and the region, working with Martor, Justrite and Röetzmeier. We always take care to offer products that solve the problem at its source.
home.solutionsText: We offer functional and high quality products for changing customer needs, and remain a reliable solution partner.
home.servicesText: Product sales, technical support, risk analysis and training consultancy to strengthen your occupational safety.
home.instagramText: Follow us for up-to-date frames from production, projects and factory life.
